blocks.title: Ask Vetta to find it on Zhihu
blocks.description: Search discussions, request an answer or check current trending topics without leaving your Vetta conversation.

showcase.user_prompt: What is trending on Zhihu today? Pick the technology topics and include links.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll check the current list, pick relevant technology topics and include the available source links so you can explore them.

blocks.title: One connection, several ways to explore

items.title: Find relevant discussions
items.description: Describe a question or a topic in your own words and ask Vetta to search Zhihu.

items.title: Get an explanation
items.description: Ask a focused question or follow up on something you found.

items.title: Explore what is current
items.description: View trending topics and narrow them to an area you care about.

blocks.title: One-time preparation
blocks.content: This connection requires your own Zhihu Access Secret and the local helper uv. Vetta does not currently install uv automatically. Follow the links below to prepare them, then restart Vetta. First use downloads supporting files and may take longer.

items.title: Install Zhihu Search
items.description: Select this member inside Zhihu Research and choose Install. Add Zhihu Research Guide too if you want guidance on research and sources.

items.title: Enter your access key
items.description: Paste the Access Secret into Vetta’s protected setup field and finish configuration. You do not need to edit configuration files.

items.title: Ask in chat
items.description: Once connected, ask Vetta to find a discussion, explain a question or check trending topics. Manage the connection under My Abilities.

blocks.title: Your account and quota
blocks.content: Requests use your Zhihu quota. Keep the access key out of chats and shared logs. The connection supports some account-related actions and content creation beyond search; use those only when you explicitly request them.
